description: This file contains user-definable functions and templates for the Qhull library, including functions for error handling, printing help messages, and managing memory sizes. It includes code for running and error handling in Qhull, as well as detailed help messages for various error conditions.

methods.name: qh_new_qhull
methods.description: Runs the Qhull algorithm with specified parameters, initializing the hull, handling errors, and producing output.

methods.name: qh_errexit
methods.description: Handles errors during Qhull execution, printing diagnostics and exiting.

methods.name: qh_errprint
methods.description: Prints detailed information about facets, ridges, and vertices related to an error.

methods.name: qh_printhelp_degenerate
methods.description: Prints help message for precision errors during hull construction.

methods.name: qh_printhelp_internal
methods.description: Prints help message for internal errors in Qhull.

methods.name: qh_printhelp_narrowhull
methods.description: Warns about a narrow initial hull, indicating potential issues with input dimensionality.

methods.name: qh_printhelp_singular
methods.description: Prints help message for degenerate or lower-dimensional input.

methods.name: qh_printhelp_topology
methods.description: Prints help message for topology errors during hull merging.

methods.name: qh_printhelp_wide
methods.description: Prints help message for wide merge errors.

methods.name: qh_user_memsizes
methods.description: Allows user to allocate additional quick memory sizes for Qhull.
